persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a simple wide illustration of a desk viewed from above: an open laptop in the middle, a yellow cup to its left, and a closed blue notebook to its right. Leave space between them. No text, 16:9.
bank.Viewpoint: Looking straight down at the desk.
bank.Object positions: Open laptop in the middle, yellow cup on the viewer's left of it, closed blue notebook on the viewer's right.
bank.Spacing: Leave visible space between the three objects.
bank.Illustration style: Simple illustration; other style details are your call.

messages.text: Could you make a simple illustration of a desk viewed from above? I've had this little desk scene in mind for a while and finally wanted to see it as an image. What I mean is an open laptop in the middle, with a yellow cup to its left and a closed blue notebook to its right, in a wide 16:9 image. I tend to overthink how these little arrangements will look once they're drawn. Please leave space between the three objects. There shouldn't be any text.
